title: feat(mcp): generate the agent tool reference and local prompt from the tool table
body:
## What changed

- A new module, `crates/app/src/mcp/catalog.rs`, reads the live MCP tool table. It makes:
  - the Markdown tool reference (`reference_markdown`),
  - the compact local-model prompt (`local_prompt`),
  - the shared working rules (`RULES`).
- `camcraft-cli mcp reference` prints the reference. `camcraft-cli mcp prompt` prints the local prompt. `camcraft-cli mcp --help` lists the two words.
- The local Prompt-JSON context (`provider::prompt_context`) now starts with `RULES`. The old format sentence follows it without a change.
- `docs/agents/mcp-tools.md` is the generated reference: 116 tools, with their arguments and full descriptions.
- New thin wrappers, with no tool list of their own:
  - `.agents/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md` for Codex CLI and Antigravity.
  - `GEMINI.md` for Gemini CLI.
  - Codex reads `AGENTS.md`, and its skill table already names `camcraft-mcp`. `AGENTS.md` does not change.
- `site/content/guide/automate/mcp.md` now names the 34 live tools that it did not name before. Examples: `edit_machine`, `suggest_cutting_data`, `delete_tool`, `edit_tool`, `pick_in_box`, `electrode_from_faces`, `set_units`, `set_program`. A new paragraph tells how to get the reference and the local prompt.
- `tools::all` is now `pub(super)`, so that the catalog reads the same rows as `tools/list`.
- `docs/decisions/1947-mcp-single-source.md` records the choices.

## Cause

The skill, the guide and the local prompt were written by hand. Nothing compared them with the tool table, so they drifted.

## Tests

The new file `crates/app/tests/mcp_doc_drift.rs` has six pins:

- `the_committed_reference_matches_the_live_tool_table`: the failure message gives the command that writes the reference again.
- `every_tool_named_in_the_agent_docs_is_live`: it scans the Claude skill, the `.agents` skill, `GEMINI.md` and the guide.
- `every_live_tool_is_in_the_guide_and_the_local_prompt`
- `the_local_prompt_json_context_carries_the_shared_rules`
- `the_scanner_finds_a_tool_call_and_a_table_name`: this proves that the scanner can find a dead name.
- `the_drift_suite_maps_the_tool_table_catalog_and_prompt_context`: the suite must name the tool table, catalog, provider and fallback in its Gate map.

Results on the code before the fix: the pins failed. The guide did not name 34 live tools, and the reference did not exist.

Mutation checks. Each mutation made a pin fail. Each restore made all five initial pins pass again.

- The guide from `upstream/main`: `every_live_tool_is_in_the_guide_and_the_local_prompt` failed.
- `fallback.rs` from `upstream/main`: `the_local_prompt_json_context_carries_the_shared_rules` failed.
- The `undo` row removed from the reference: `the_committed_reference_matches_the_live_tool_table` failed.

## Review fixes and final validation

Head: `26a09578688587d2c8849a66507e371369a98586`.
Base: `upstream/main` at `08697d3c422a2f6ade1f3e1fd9970b16ed3177eb`.

- Merged current main without conflicts. Generated the reference again. Only the `import_model` row changed.
- Added Gate maps for `app::mcp::tools`, `app::mcp::catalog`, `app::mcp::provider` and `app::mcp::fallback`.
- A temporary tool-only diff selected `mcp_doc_drift` in the real quick plan. Restored the temporary edit.
- Restored the stale reference: `the_committed_reference_matches_the_live_tool_table` failed. Restored the generated reference: passed.
- Removed the Gate map: `the_drift_suite_maps_the_tool_table_catalog_and_prompt_context` failed. Restored the map: passed.
- All six drift pins pass after the restores.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: PASS. 127 steps. 978 tests passed, nine ignored, none failed. Duration: 10.4 minutes.
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`: FAIL. 200 actual steps, one failed. Duration: 38.1 minutes.
- The sole unexpected failure was `app heavy: pocket3d_hsm`, test `the_users_bore_roughs_adaptive_level_by_level_and_verifies_clean`.
  At `crates/app/tests/pocket3d_hsm.rs:144`, the Linux count expected `(4726, 4698, 549)` and received `(3158, 3130, 1141)`.
  This PR changes neither that test nor the machining algorithms. The test and algorithms remain unchanged.
- The heavy run also reported the expected failures for #2845 (two tests), #2849 (three tests) and #1950 (one test).

The heavy gate selected the app heavy targets. These targets ran tests:

| Lane | Result |
|---|---|
| `app heavy: adaptive_fig8_crossing` | PASS: 2 |
| `app heavy: adaptive_pinch` | PASS: 1 |
| `app heavy: carried_engine_agreement` | PASS: 1 |
| `app heavy: feature_pick_wire` | PASS: 1 |
| `app heavy: import_solidcraft` | PASS: 3 |
| `app heavy: large_models` | PASS: 1 |
| `app heavy: lathe_field_sim` | PASS: 1 |
| `app heavy: lathe_workholding_kinds` | PASS: 1 |
| `app heavy: operations` | PASS: 6 |
| `app heavy: pick_agnostic` | PASS: 2 |
| `app heavy: rotary_field_parity` | PASS: 6 |
| `app heavy: shared_face_bodies_finish` | PASS: 6 |
| `app heavy: shoulder_adaptive` | PASS: 1; one expected failure (#2849) |
| `app heavy: stock_engine_agreement` | PASS: 3 |
| `app heavy: stock_field_cost` | PASS: 1 |
| `app heavy: stock_play_precalc` | PASS: 1 |
| `app heavy: verify` | PASS: 2 |
| `app heavy: whole_model_pocket` | PASS: 1 |
| `app heavy: pocket3d_hsm` | FAIL: one unexpected failure; one expected failure (#1950) |
| `app heavy: feature_edge_g1_join` | One expected failure (#2845) |
| `app heavy: winding_align` | One expected failure (#2845) |
| `app heavy: lead_approach` | Two expected failures (#2849) |

Other selected targets had no ignored tests to run. The run passed 40 tests and found one unexpected failure. Six tests had expected failures.

A separate run of the failed bore test failed again with the same counts (2.42 seconds).

- The heavy gate remains red. This PR remains a draft.
- `cargo clippy -j 12 -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: PASS. Duration: 1 minute, 14 seconds.

## Goldens moved

None. No `.nc` or `.cl` file changed.

## Held: the Claude skill edit

This session could not write under `.claude/`. A write there needs an approval prompt. Thus, this PR does not change `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md`. The issue has a comment with the exact patch and its pin:

- Remove the shipped `set_units`, `set_program` and face lay from "Known Remaining Gaps".
- Link the generated reference.
- Add the pin `the_known_gaps_name_no_shipped_tool`.

For this reason the PR says `Refs #1947`, not `Fixes`.

## Commits

The first two commits retain the original work history. The first commit was squashed onto a `main` that moved during the gate. Thus, it also reverted other merged work. The second commit restores the tree of `main` and keeps only the 11 files of this issue. Read the whole PR diff, not the first commit alone. Force-push is forbidden, so the history stays as it is. A merge commit keeps the tree of the PR head, which is correct.

## Not exercised

- A real Codex, Gemini, Antigravity or local-model client. The tests check the text only.
- The AI Chat panel with a live local endpoint. The panel has no transport in this release.

## Overlaps

None of these PRs changes the same lines:

- #2554 and #2678 change other functions in `crates/app/src/mcp/mod.rs`. This PR adds one `pub mod` line.
- This PR does not touch the skill file, so it has no overlap with #2924, #2920, #2915, #2910, #2799, #2773, #2716 or #2678.
- An open PR that adds an MCP tool must also run `camcraft-cli mcp reference` and name its tool in the guide. If it does not, the new pins fail after it merges.

Changelog: `camcraft-cli mcp reference` and `camcraft-cli mcp prompt` print the MCP tool reference and a compact local-model prompt from the live tool table; the MCP guide now names every tool.

Refs #1947
